hero.subtitle: Authorization Code Exchange for web and mobile — Sign In with LinkedIn using OpenID Connect setup, API reference, and frontend examples.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: LinkedIn login is optional and controlled by LINKEDIN_AUTH_ENABLED. When disabled, LinkedIn endpoints return 503 Service Unavailable. JWTs are never placed in the redirect URL; the API issues a one-time exchangeCode (Redis, 60 seconds). The same POST /auth/exchange endpoint is shared with other social providers.
items: Custom passport-oauth2 strategy + LinkedinAuthGuard (not legacy passport-linkedin)
Profile fetched via GET /v2/userinfo after token exchange
Same token response shape as POST /auth/login

console.title: LinkedIn Developer Portal → My apps
console.description: Create an app under LinkedIn Developer Portal → My apps. Request the Sign In with LinkedIn using OpenID Connect product. Set the redirect URI to match LINKEDIN_CALLBACK_URL. Scopes: openid profile email.
steps: Open https://www.linkedin.com/developers/apps and create a new app
Under Products, request Sign In with LinkedIn using OpenID Connect
Ensure scopes openid, profile, and email are enabled
Copy Client ID and Client Secret into your .env
Ensure LINKEDIN_CALLBACK_URL matches the redirect URI registered in LinkedIn

env.title: Environment variables
env.description: Loaded from .env via src/config/linkedin-oauth.config.ts (namespace linkedinOAuth on ConfigService). See .env.example.

roles.title: Default roles for new LinkedIn users
roles.description: New LinkedIn users receive roles: [] by default (same as password register). Set LINKEDIN_OAUTH_DEFAULT_ROLES in .env to a comma-separated list of Role values (e.g. user or user,manager). Existing users linked by email keep their current roles.

flow.title: Sequence
items: User consents on LinkedIn; browser hits GET /api/v1/auth/linkedin/callback
API calls GET /v2/userinfo, upserts user, stores exchangeCode in Redis, redirects to redirect?code=...
Client POSTs { code } to /api/v1/auth/exchange and receives JWTs

start.title: 1. Start OAuth
start.description: Opens LinkedIn consent. Query redirect must match a prefix in LINKEDIN_REDIRECT_ALLOWLIST (or omit to use the first allowlist entry).

callback.title: 2. Callback
callback.description: Handled by the API. Redirects to your app with ?code= (or &code= if the URL already has a query).

exchange.title: 3. Exchange code
exchange.description: Public endpoint shared with other social providers. Consumes the code (single use) and returns the same shape as login.

web.title: Frontend — Web (SPA)
web.description: Typical flow: button starts OAuth in the same window (or popup); a callback route on your frontend origin reads code from the query string and calls exchange.
notes: Add your frontend callback URL to LINKEDIN_REDIRECT_ALLOWLIST (e.g. http://localhost:5173/auth/callback)
LINKEDIN_CALLBACK_URL must point at the Nest API, not the SPA
Store accessToken / refreshToken securely (memory + httpOnly cookie patterns as you prefer)

mobile.title: Frontend — Mobile (deep link)
mobile.description: Use a custom scheme (or universal link) in the allowlist. After LinkedIn, the API redirects to myapp://success?code=.... The app opens, parses the code, and calls exchange.
notes: Register the scheme in the OS / Expo app.json
Exchange over HTTPS against your API base URL

security.title: Security notes
items: Redirect URLs must match LINKEDIN_REDIRECT_ALLOWLIST prefixes
Exchange codes are single-use and expire in 60 seconds (Redis)
Existing local users are linked by verified LinkedIn email (linkedinId set; roles unchanged)
LinkedIn-only users have password null — password login / change-password will fail until a password is set
Email is required from GET /v2/userinfo; login fails if LinkedIn does not return an email (scopes openid profile email)

userModel.title: User model
userModel.description: Postgres entity / interface fields used by LinkedIn login:
items: linkedinId — unique nullable LinkedIn OIDC subject (sub from userinfo)
isActive — set true for new LinkedIn users
